desc: 细罗纹贴身不紧绷、圆领长袖、一套多穿的都市打底上衣
name: 罗纹修身长袖打底上衣款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼给出贴身廓形与罗纹质感，拿下点击。
一秒讲清罗纹拉伸后回弹贴身这一核心卖点。
放大普通长袖穿久鼓包透薄的日常烦恼，引出本品。
把上衣放进真实通勤出街场景，让买家自我代入。
用针脚与罗纹微距证明面料做工与弹性来源。
展示后背整片无接缝与加长袖口，打消版型疑虑。
同一件上衣两种穿法并列，讲清百搭值回价格。
平铺出同一件上衣的多种下装搭配，让用户做选择。
用留空参数栏与空印章框承接售后信任，不编造资质。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cool studio white #FFFFFF for the opening packshot, matte cement-grey #BFBDB8 and slate #3E4247 editorial fields for benefit and macro screens, one shallow-focus street stone #A9A49C field for the lifestyle screen; flat low-contrast surfaces only, no gradient, no storefront lettering
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in accent #B0483F, maximum two per screen, otherwise none
style.lightingSystem: soft daylight-balanced 5600K key from the front-left with a fill card on the shadow side, gentle falloff, low contrast, soft contact shadow only, no harsh specular on the knit
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent urban editorial womenswear basics visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool studio white #FFFFFF, matte cement-grey #BFBDB8, deep slate #3E4247 and one brick-red accent #B0483F; cool daylight-balanced 5600K light with a soft front-left key, fill card, low contrast and soft contact shadows only; flat low-contrast backdrop fields with no gradients and no signage; modern geometric sans-serif kept out of the frame with every wording slot left as an empty rail; thin single-weight line icons in the accent only where a proof rail appears; faceless torso framing cropped above the collarbone or below the jaw, garment worn or laid flat with a visible contact shadow, stable scale and stable slight 3/4 body read; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no identifiable model identity.
noDrift: no identifiable model face or personal styling
no rendered brand marks or storefront signage
style.presentationRules: faceless torso framing cropped above the collarbone or below the jaw, one consistent slight 3/4 body read for the garment, garment always worn or laid flat with contact shadow, stable scale across the whole set
style.surfaceSystem: matte cement-grey studio board #BFBDB8, cool plaster wall #EDEBE8, off-white flat-lay field #F2F0EC, and the fine vertical rib of the knit itself as the macro surface
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for optional single-line labels only; every wording slot is left as an empty rail, no rendered copy inside the images
